target_mapping.rule: MAPPING-SENSITIVITY M3: contiguous monotone 4->3 partition alternative to the frozen M1. The three contiguous partitions of 4 ordered points into 3 non-empty groups are: M1={0}|{1}|{2,3} (frozen), M2={0}|{1,2}|{3}, M3={0,1}|{2}|{3}. Under the frozen normalized profile middle==deep==1.193490054249548, so M1 and M2 yield the IDENTICAL per-point vector; M3 is the only distinct alternative. M3: shallow={point0,point1}, middle={point2}, deep={point3}.
